metadata.title: Masor Petu aru Bhat Bhaji | Assamese Recipe
metadata.description:
Masor Petu aru Bhat Bhaji or Fish intestine fried rice is a quite a delicacy in the rural Assam. Fish intestines are consumed by the various tribes of the Northeast India, the fish guts are properly cleaned and prepared and are use to flavour rice in this dish. 

Fish guts has a slight bitter bile like taste an is an acquired taste. Normally fish intestines of carps raised in your won backyard is used, seas fish are not used.
